name: clearcue
description: Find companies and people showing buying intent on LinkedIn and the web, and act on them from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Find companies and people showing buying intent, and act on them.
interface.longDescription: Clearcue watches LinkedIn and the web for the moments that signal a company is ready to buy: new hires in the roles you sell to, job posts, funding, competitor engagement, event attendance and more. Connect your Clearcue workspace to rank your hottest accounts, prepare pre-call briefs, find decision makers, write signal-based messages, build target lists from conferences, and set up new signals in plain language.
defaultPrompt: Show me my 10 hottest accounts this week in Clearcue.
Prepare a one-page brief for my call with Acme.
Suggest which buying signals I should track for my company.
